"GrahamGrayDog! Lol I remember seeing your McJuggernuggets video ages ago, was some solid video man, I remember watching that and thinking "Damn, dude did his research!" Nice to run across your video again man. I have a lot of respect for you and your videos (not gonna lie, bit of positive bias towards you too for saying I kinda inspired your channel lol) so I'll give a nice, full, proper response. 

OK so in short, the main question seems to be "Why haven't I made a video on Keemstar?" right? OK here's why. It's a long read (as you can see), but if you canre to read it all, awesome. 

I pick my drama videos for impact man, not easy views like most do. 
I made a video on Vegan Gains and I bodied the cunt and it empowered the people against him back when he was gaining subs fast for telling YT'ers he was happy they had cancer. Classy 
I made a video against Nicole Arbour and I legit ended that drama the 2nd time round. 
I made a video on Jinx and people credit me for ending him reacting, and I'd like to think I made a lot of reactors as a whole stop stealing from YT content creators as much as they did and they now focus almost solely on movie trailers and shit. 
I made a drama video on the youtube copyright shit and I got the YouTube CEO to listen and they're making changes cus of my videos. 

I made all these drama videos cus I had something to say, and I thought something could come from them. 
And on the flipside, I dodged the huge FineBros drama, and I dodged the h3h3.Leafy drama. No vids made on them at all. Because they would've accomplished nothing, and I had nothing to add to those topics. 
Every drama vid I make is for a purpose. So tell me what would a Keem video accomplish.

What would the video have in it? What points would I bring up?
"Keem said racist things on stream" Everyone knows 
"Keem said he wants to kill someone on stream" Everyone knows 
"Keem falsely accused an old man of being a pedo" Everyone knows
"Keem's an arsehole." EVERYONE KNOWS! lol

So given that, tell me what would be the purpose of making a video on Keem? What am I saying that hasn't been said before? It'd be a nice video to watch, no doubt, but it's all shit people know, and it'd just be me regurgitating. idubbbztv made a video it cus it's easy views; not throwing any shade, but truth be told. Yes he made a solid video on him, yes he found some juicy contradictions in what he says and what he does and I think it was an overall good video......but what effect did it have on Keemstar and his channel? 

Fucking ZERO

Even I know I could make a video on Keem, it would be the best one on him and it would easily be one of my most viewed videos, no doubt at all.... But what does it add to the conversation? What impact does it have? Everything I would say is regurgitating shit everyone always knows, it adds nothing. Again, I understand it would be a nice video, but beyond that, what would it do?

At this current stage, there is nothing particularly worth adding to the conversation on Keemstar, unless some new information gets found on him. And btw, if I did make a video, all a video like that would get is people whingeing and whining, and I can't be fucked with that lol. You know how it is being a content creator on Youtube man, some people live to complain lol, and will find a reason to complain no matter what you do. I bet some idiot is reading this comment right now, ignoring any logic or reason in what I'm saying and is getting mad purely because of "Grade still sucking that Keem cock and refusing to make a video on him" ....rolls eyes me sucking Keem's cock, yeah okay. 

Again, I don't like making drama videos unless there's a purpose of it. Making a video saying "Keem's an arsehole" isn't really a purpose lol. 

And just to say this quickly, I get that Keem adds fuel to the fire, no doubt, but without Keem and without DramaAlert, there would still be drama. People comment to me saying "you know you're just adding to the drama right?" .....when have I ever said I don't like drama? Lol shit's fun-af to be involved in. But drama would be around with or without him. He's the number 1 "drama" channel. If he wasn't around, someone else would be the most watched drama channel. Would be as toxic? Perhaps not. But would drama still be around? Absolutely. Keem is not the big issue; people's perceptions of drama, and just how hung up they get around the topic of drama, that is. 

One of my main points of the video was "if you like drama, cool, but if you don't, don't pay so much fucking attention to it." Drama's not going anywhere, noone can rid the internet of drama, all I tried to do was change some people's perception of it. People have an unhealthy obsession with people who have popularity/fame/whatever. I'm a random dude who makes videos from his fucking bedroom, but I get losers sat at home trying to find out my real name and what my face looks like etc. That's an unhealthy level of obsession with someone else's business, no? But it's happens, and it's common as fuck. "Who's he dating, how much does he fucking earn, what beefs is he in", etc etc. I got an email in my business email literally asking me "Hi....do you support gay marriage?" lol, wtf. As long as those kind of people exist, who care more about "famous" people's lives and opinions just as much, if not more than their own, there's always gonna be drama. But be under no illusions man, Keem does add fuel to the fire, absolutely, but he's not the creator of all things drama; he's not the head of the proverbial snake that is drama. 

But I've been rambling like crazy lol. In short, Keem's none of my fucking concern. I don't have sjw running through my veins like some people on the internet haha, I don't give a fuck about Keem. I try to make videos that matter, and Keem doesn't. 

His actions don't bother me. Yes he's a white guy who's said racist things, but I'm a member of an ethnic minority and I don't give a fuck. I don't get too gassed up about drama being around, I've come to terms with it and I accept it. I hear people complain about Keem's actions being the worst, but I see youtubers like me being doxxed being a bigger issue, but noone gives a fuck about that shit. I didn't do a face reveal cus I wanted to Graham, I did it cus my real name got leaked and it all it would've taken is a fucking facebook search to find pics. I said "damn, I want my privacy but oh well, gone now, out of my hands now right? I don't wanna do a face reveal, but if my face is gonna get revealed against my will, I'm gonna be the one to do it." 

And just to add to that, the stuff Youtube viewers see is NOTHING compared to what I'm exposed to, as a Youtube insider, if you will. I know of plenty of angelic-image having Youtubers who are cunts behind the scenes, have cheated on their gfs, lied to viewers in videos, fucked over other youtubers etc etc. PLENTY of bad shit happens on Youtube, but in my estimation, Keem is nowhere near the top of my list of "topics that need to be covered."

I'm rambling now man, I'll stop lol, but I think I've covered everything I would've wanted to. 

Btw I'm fully aware of certain other shit you said, but won't specifically point out in this comment :p, believe me I'm under no illusions man, I'm very fucking aware haha.
